hints.tr: Alanla aynı adda metot yazılabilir: `fn value(&self) -> u32 { self.value }`.
hints.en: A method can share a field's name: `fn value(&self) -> u32 { self.value }`.

tests.code: let mut c = Counter::new(); c.increment(); c.increment(); assert_eq!(c.value(), 2);
let mut c = Counter::new(); c.increment(); c.reset(); assert_eq!(c.value(), 0);
